title: Hemomancy
subtitle: The blood remembers
text: Hemomancy is the awakening and direction of power latent within blood — power seeded into living things by a vast, ancient organism over the course of centuries. It is not learned. It is remembered. The knowledge was always there, waiting in the blood for someone willing enough to let it speak. Whether that is a gift or a colonization is a question each practitioner must answer for themselves.
